basis_grounds: Installed official Blender axis_conversion defaults from_forward=Y/from_up=Z; FBX preset to_forward=-Z/to_up=Y gives A(x,y,z)=(x,z,-y).
Unity left-handed +X right/+Y up/+Z forward; FBX RH to Unity LH conversion reflects X. C=H*A: (-x,z,-y).
Read-only HOLMES06 undeformed native Mesh reflects X*0.01; Renderer matrix rotates X -90deg and scales100, consistent with C. No06 rerun; no07 observation used.
tolerance_rule: float32 u=2^-24. Position component envelope128*u*B, B=max(1,max_i(abs(t_i)+sum_j(abs(Mij)*halfedge_j))). Normal envelope256*u*scaleCondition with scaleCondition=1.5/0.75=2. Engineering envelope fixed before new consumer, not a formal bound on every importer operation.
winding: cross(Ma,Mb)=det(M)*inverseTranspose(M)*cross(a,b). Record Object determinant and C determinant separately. Native raw world triangle cross dot outward normal must have actual Renderer determinant sign when source front local winding is retained. Det-aware parity dot=sign(RendererDet)*rawDot>=0.999999. Negative RendererDet indicates reflection retained; positive with B/C equal indicates mirror baked into geometry. D is analytic parity, not rendered front-face proof; real CullBack outside/inside on untouched-Mesh observational clone establishes E. No observer culling override.
